blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) allowed former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez’s staff to attend to his needs inside his cell, its personnel told the Sandiganbayan Third Division. The Third Division is handling the plunder case against Romualdez stemming from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. During the court hearing, Jail Superintendent Maria Lourdes Pacion confirmed that Romualdez’s staff was allowed inside his cell. Associate Justice Karl Miranda, Third Division chair, asked if this was allowed under BJMP rules. “We allow that if the patient is not in good condition,” Pacion told the […]...
